source: Verified research, Junie CLI ([Junie] rows of the Zed/Aider/Goose/Droid/Auggie/Junie entry): junie.jetbrains.com/docs/junie-cli-hooks.html; hooks are an Early Access feature (skeptic: hook_pre_tool corrected, hook_session_start and hook_stop confirmed).

selection.sniffNote: The verified research names no Junie hook env var, so Junie is picked by --agent junie or CI_AGENT.
selection.bareNote: Junie's payload is Claude-shaped; Junie documents a top-level decision field, not hookSpecificOutput, so a Junie run relies on --agent junie for the exit 2 deny.

deny.source: [Junie] hook_pre_tool: exit 2 blocks no matter what is printed.

context.source: [Junie] hook_session_start: SessionStart additionalContext is ignored, so lessons go to ~/.junie/AGENTS.md (plan PR 11).

PreToolUse.source: Junie hook_payload_example: one line of JSON from junie-cli-hooks.html

PostToolUse.source: [Junie] hook_post_tool: the payload carries tool_response, tool_use_id and duration_ms

SessionStart.source: [Junie] hook_session_start: SessionStart fires with source, cwd, session_id and project_path

SessionEnd.source: [Junie] hook_pre_tool skeptic: SessionEnd has a 2 s default timeout; its input keys are not in the verified research

Stop.source: [Junie] hook_stop: the payload has stop_hook_active and last_assistant_message

evidence.source: Junie hook_payload_example (one JSON line: hook_event_name, tool_name, tool_input, cwd, session_id) and hook_post_tool (tool_response, tool_use_id, duration_ms); Read and Edit are Junie tool names
